card.name: The 'per' in dose rates
card.fires_on: The word per, or the unit just before it, inside a dose rate such as mg per kg or mL per second. Also the slash or mg right before /kg in weight-based dosing.

modes.label: Per in rates
modes.description: The word per or a space before it, linking an amount to a unit of weight or time.

modes.label: Weight-based units
modes.description: mg or /kg in weight-based dose expressions.

modes.label: Other instruction words
modes.description: Linking or verb-part words in administration directions, such as of before applesauce.
